snippet.title: Dismayed  | First Official Game | JollyRat
snippet.description:
Live the role of the main protagonist James to try to make sense of your confusing and twisted surroundings. Will you figure out what's going on? Or will you cave to the madness.

Official Download Link:  https://jollyrat.itch.io/dismayed
